rationale: The event trace passes both hard constraints: (1) the resource remains connected throughout the voltage sag with all voltage samples within their time-envelope limits (0.55 pu at t=0.05-0.12s within the 0.5 pu minimum for up to 0.7s envelope, and 0.9 pu at t=0.55s within the 0.85 pu minimum for up to 2.0s envelope), and (2) reactive current support meets the minimum requirement: iq_pu reaches 0.25 pu at t=0.12s, which is within the 0.1s response deadline (by t=0.15s) from the voltage sag onset at t=0.05s and exceeds the 0.2 pu minimum requirement.
